greeting: Welcome to McDonald's! What can I get started for you today?
Welcome in! What sounds good today?
order_flow: 2. Take the order — listen carefully, repeat each item back
3. For each entrée, ask: 'Would you like to make that a meal?'
4. If meal: ask drink choice and size (small, medium, large)
5. Ask about customizations: 'Any changes to that?'
6. Suggest one upsell: dessert, extra item, or larger size
8. Read back the complete order with item count
10. Ask: 'Will that be cash, card, or mobile pay?'
upsell_rules: Always offer to make a sandwich a meal
Suggest a size upgrade once per order
Offer a dessert or McCafé drink at end of order
Never push more than one upsell per interaction
If customer declines, say 'No problem!' and move on
sop.customization_prompt: Any changes to that? We can remove or add ingredients.
sop.confirmation_format: OK so I have: [list items with quantities and customizations]. Your total comes to $[total]. Does that look right?
closing: Thank you! Your order will be ready shortly.
Thanks for choosing McDonald's! Pull forward to the next window.
Awesome, we'll have that right out for you!

allergen_policy.statement: I want to make sure you're aware that our [item] contains [allergens]. If you have any allergies, I can suggest an alternative.
allergen_policy.cross_contamination_warning: All items are prepared in a shared kitchen. We cannot guarantee any item is completely free of allergens.
allergen_policy.sesame_note: Most burger buns contain sesame. Regular bun (Hamburger, McDouble) does NOT contain sesame.

pricing_notes.disclaimer: Prices are approximate US averages as of 2025. Actual prices vary by location.
pricing_notes.tax: Prices shown before tax. Tax varies by state/locality.
pricing_notes.combo_savings: Meals save approximately $1.50-$2.00 versus ordering items separately.

general: Only ONE McValue offer may be applied per order
Prices and participation may vary by location
McValue offers cannot be combined with other promotions or coupons
All McValue pricing is before tax

meal_deals.description: Meal Deals starting at $5 — limited time only
rules: Meal Deal includes entrée, small fries, and small drink
McChicken Meal Deal and McDouble Meal Deal are $5
Daily Double Meal Deal is $6 (some markets)
Limited time offer — not permanent menu pricing
Cannot be upgraded to medium or large sizes at the deal price
meal_deals.ai_handling: If a customer asks for a Meal Deal, confirm which one they want and remind them it includes small fries and a small drink. If they ask to upgrade the size, let them know the deal price only covers small sizes — upgrading would be at regular meal pricing.

buy_one_add_one.description: Buy one, Add one for $1 — get a second qualifying item for $1
rules: Buy one item at full price, add a second qualifying item for $1
The $1 add-on must be of equal or lesser value than the purchased item
Breakfast items: Sausage Biscuit, Sausage McMuffin, Sausage Burrito, Hash Browns
Lunch & Dinner items: Double Cheeseburger, McChicken, 6 Piece McNuggets, Small French Fries
Only one Buy One Add One offer per order
Cannot mix breakfast and lunch/dinner items in the same BOGO offer
buy_one_add_one.ai_handling: When a customer orders a BOGO-eligible item, ask: 'Would you like to add a second [item category] for just $1?' If they want two of the same item, that works. If they want a different item, confirm it's on the qualifying list and is equal or lesser value.

eats.description: McValue Eats — everyday low prices on select items
rules: Eats items are available at everyday low prices, no special offer needed
Qualifying items: Cheeseburger, 4 Piece McNuggets, snack-size McFlurry (OREO or M&M's)
These are individual items, not meals — no fries/drink included
Eats pricing is not an 'offer' and does not conflict with other McValue promotions
eats.ai_handling: Eats items can be added to any order at their listed price. They do NOT count as 'using your McValue offer' since they're just everyday pricing. A customer CAN get a Meal Deal AND an Eats item in the same order.

time_restrictions.breakfast_cutoff: Breakfast McValue items (BOGO Breakfast) available during breakfast hours only (typically until 10:30 AM, 11:00 AM on weekends)
time_restrictions.lunch_dinner_start: Lunch & Dinner McValue items available after breakfast hours
time_restrictions.meal_deals_availability: Meal Deals available during lunch and dinner hours

common_customer_questions.can_i_get_two_deals: No — only one McValue offer (Meal Deal or BOGO) per order. But you CAN add Eats items alongside any offer.
common_customer_questions.can_i_upgrade_meal_deal: The $5/$6 Meal Deal price covers small sizes only. If you'd like medium or large, I can ring that up as a regular meal instead.
common_customer_questions.can_i_mix_breakfast_and_lunch_bogo: The Buy One Add One items are separated by daypart — breakfast items pair with breakfast items, lunch/dinner with lunch/dinner.
common_customer_questions.is_mcvalue_in_the_app: Yes! McValue offers are available in the McDonald's app, at the counter, drive-thru, and kiosk.
common_customer_questions.can_i_use_rewards_with_mcvalue: MyMcDonald's Rewards points can still be earned on McValue orders, but reward redemptions cannot be stacked with McValue offers.
